cohort: The study included all cases of intrapartum fetal deaths in Ireland from 2011-2014 and unexpected neonatal deaths from 2012-2014.
finding: The overall intrapartum death rate was 0.29 per 1000 births (corrected 0.16 per 1000 births), and the overall unexpected neonatal death rate was 0.17 per 1000 live births, with major congenital malformation, chorioamnionitis, placental abruption, and hypoxic ischaemic encephalopathy identified as leading causes.
followup_time: Up to 28 days after birth for unexpected neonatal deaths; N/A for intrapartum fetal deaths as observation concludes at birth.
